picks.title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
picks.excerpt: Artists are frustrated with the lack of transparency around DistroKid removing their songs.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool; the distributor indie artists use is now pulling tracks without notice, which matters to anyone releasing music, AI-assisted or not.

picks.title: New Suno live music division to help make it the "first creative entertainment platform"
picks.excerpt: Part of Suno's licensing deal with Warner Music Group last November involved acquiring concert-discovery platform Songkick. It felt like a strange quirk at the time – what does an AI music-generating platform have to do with live gigs? – but now we'll find out how this seemingly odd-couple relationship will work.
picks.rationale: New Suno announcement: a live-music division built on Songkick that takes the AI music platform beyond generation and into concerts.

picks.title: Grimes Shares First Song From AI-Inspired Album Psy Opera
picks.excerpt: The album promises to cover everything the singer "witnessed as a woman of history during her hiatus from pop music"
picks.rationale: New release: a major artist who has embraced AI puts out the first single from an AI-themed album, which gives the brief an artist angle.

picks.title: Fender revamps its website with AI tool and more artist content
picks.excerpt: Fender has been more than just a maker of instruments for some time now. In the last decade we've written about its moves in music education, its Fender Studio music-making app and its Fender Next artist-development program for example.
picks.rationale: Product launch: a major instrument maker adds an AI tool to its site, showing AI reaching guitar players directly.

picks.title: Towards AI-Generated Music Plagiarism Detection as a Version Identification Problem
picks.excerpt: The rapid expansion of text-to-music generative models challenges traditional paradigms of music creation and intellectual property. Plagiarism in this context is rarely an absolute mathematical binary, but an ambiguous threshold negotiated over harmonic structure, melodic contours, or overall perceived stylistic character. In this work, we test the transferability of state-of-the-art music versio
picks.rationale: New research that tests cover-song (version) identification models as a way to detect plagiarism in AI-generated music, the technical side of the ongoing copyright fights.

https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1.new_action: DistroKid has begun removing songs from its catalogue in response to the UMG lawsuit. This is a new action by the defendant; the 09-20 card covered only UMG's allegations.
